plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Structured code review and repository audit. Reviews a diff, branch or pull request against correctness, security, performance and accessibility, and reports findings ranked by severity with a concrete failure scenario for each. Use when asked to review code, audit a PR, or check quality before merging.

plugins.name: job-hunter
plugins.description: Runs a job or contract search as a pipeline instead of a pile of tabs. Scores a posting against a declared profile and says pursue or skip with the reason, tailors the application to that one posting, and tracks every opportunity through its stages with follow-ups that come due. Use when reviewing a job ad, gig or RFP, deciding whether to apply or bid, writing a proposal, cover letter or CV variant, or asking what needs chasing in the search.
